Our Story

From the Lanes of Old Delhi to Kashmir

What began as a humble stall opposite Jama Masjid, Delhi-6 became one of India's most beloved food institutions. Aslam Chicken's iconic butter-drenched grilled chicken sparked a culinary revolution — imitated everywhere, matched nowhere.

In 2024, founder Muhammad Aslam — alongside Irfan Maqbool — brought these legendary flavors to the Valley. Inaugurated by Mirwaiz Umar Farooq, the Srinagar outlet at City Centre Plaza, Karan Nagar became an instant obsession for food lovers across Kashmir.

Our secret? Marinated chicken, tandoor-grilled to perfection, then finished with a waterfall of pure Amul butter, fresh cream, and our generations-old spice blend. Paired with roomali roti and mint chutney — it's an experience, not just a meal.

"We're excited to bring the authentic flavors of Old Delhi to the heart of Kashmir."

— Muhammad Aslam, Founder
